fact: INSEED, the national statistics institute, lists the RGA-2 2025 agricultural census (73,818 family holdings enumerated, 11,454-holding sample) as an entry in its NADA microdata catalogue; no date of release is given in the body, so the document's published date is used.
INSEED's NADA microdata catalogue lists the EHCVM 2024 household survey (5,487 households) with version 1.0 of the cleaned data files and a public anonymised version, dated April 2026.

INSEED, the national statistics institute, runs a national microdata archive (NADA) whose catalogue held 15 datasets on 23 August 2026, including the 2025 agricultural census and the 2024 household survey; the page states no open licence.
